title: Concept: SWIFT MT message content in a response
description: A SWIFT MT block with its field tags in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message carries the ordering customer, the beneficiary account and the amount, so one response can disclose a whole cross-border payment rather than a single field.
applicability: Deployments that render a SWIFT MT block with its field tags into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message carries the ordering customer, the beneficiary account and the amount, so one response can disclose a whole cross-border payment rather than a single field.
